scope: Complete frozen inference on the two previously public TCGA LUAD slides; predicted geometry and identities.

segmentation.name: WholeCell v6 VitaminP-derived native H&E core

display_pyramid: Discrete aggregation of actual masks at 0.85 µm and coarser; native contours and raster measurements remain authoritative.

tissue_gate.policy: Display admission only. Pinned VitaminP _calculate_tissue_percentage on unnormalised512px RGB, threshold0.1, OR every original valid-nucleus core, then one-core3x3 dilation. Raw masks and measurements are retained; a viewer toggle exposes background-rejected predictions.
tissue_gate.brightfield_rule: RGB→gray;7x7Gaussian blur; dark pixels≤210. Original method selects modality by mean gray>100.

background_stress.interpretation: Near-white scanner noise can be amplified by per-field normalization. The viewer retains raw masks behind the background toggle; filtering is not a change in model accuracy.

original_analysis: 189 original candidate profiles, 16 intervention examples and cross-slide fidelity results remain frozen. Whole-slide morphology summaries use the expanded linked population.

default_point_layer.centroids: Exact native XY of all original analysis-valid nuclei.
default_point_layer.all47_posteriors_and_hierarchy_support: Verified against frozen v15 outputs; uint16 posteriors are display quantization only.
default_point_layer.historical_v7_1_files: Preserved unchanged, no longer the default.
